name: suggest-ownership-feedback-4
body:
Feedback spine-backfill/feedback-4 (target solution.component.deck-validator). Source: deck-validator was the sole owner of internal/suggest/suggest.go (File-level implemented-by), but suggest.Closest is a shared "did you mean …?" utility — apg_callers on go.github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide/internal/suggest.Closest returns 11 callers, only 1 of them (internal/validate.checkLabelRef) in internal/validate; the rest are internal/cli.templateUnknownMessage, internal/deck.LoadConfig, internal/slide.unknownName, internal/template.LibraryError.withSuggestion, internal/template.Registry.checkFieldType, internal/template.Registry.checkSections, internal/template.checker.unknownKey and internal/theme.Registry.Lookup (plus one test).

Inconsistency: the requirement requirements.requirement.closest-match-suggestions spells out that "unknown field, section, template, config key or theme names" all produce a suggestion — i.e. it spans every suggestion-emitting component, not just the validator — so a single component owning the shared helper misrepresented which components the helper serves.

Resolution [autonomous, option (b) of the feedback]: represented the helper honestly as cross-cutting, using the spec model's existing shared-file pattern (cf. internal/template/media.go, whose function-level anchors are shared by template-library-loader and template-registry, with no whole-file claim). (1) Removed the whole-file implemented-by solution.component.deck-validator -> internal/suggest/suggest.go. (2) Kept the function-level implemented-by solution.component.deck-validator -> internal/suggest.Closest. (3) Added function-level implemented-by -> go.github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide/internal/suggest.Closest from each genuine user component: deck-loader, slide-parser, template-library-loader, template-registry, theme-registry and cli-templates. internal/suggest/suggest.go remains owned through its suggest.Closest function, so the "every non-test Go file owned" invariant holds; the I1 spine is untouched (closest-match-suggestions -> domain.service.validate-deck -> solution.component.deck-validator -> internal/suggest.Closest still resolves). Rejected (a) single-owner-plus-body as not reflecting the requirement's span across all error sources, and rejected (c) a new shared-utility component as over-modelled for a 90-line helper package with no domain service of its own. Updated the deck-validator body to say the helper is shared, not validator-owned.
